HANGS Construction Services FY2027 estimated tax, December payment

The December 15 estimate is next and I want to get it right. On October 15 we paid $1,324.70 by EFTPS, which with the $1,838.00 overpayment from FY2026 makes $3,162.70, a quarter of the FY2026 tax of $12,650.79. Jordan thinks we can keep paying that each quarter, the way we did before the loss year.

July to September came in at $205,803.93 of book income, well under the board's budget of $572,500.00 a quarter. I revised the full-year projection; it is attached with the EFTPS history. The interim figures for 3, 6 and 9 months are in the folder; only the first three months are closed.
- How much should we pay on December 15, and are we on track for the year?
- The EFTPS confirmation for October 15 shows tax period 12/2026. I think I picked the calendar year out of habit. Does that matter?
